name: Quang Dao — Paper Mirror and Citation Catalogue
description: A machine-readable catalogue of authored papers, an unlisted external-paper mirror, and the citation closure available from allowlisted writing sources.

visibility.note: Unlisted is not access control. Anyone with a paper or manifest URL can retrieve it. The external library is not linked from the human-facing site.

collection_license_note: No blanket license is asserted over the catalogue. Read each paper's license fields. Absence of a reviewed license is not permission to redistribute.

availability_definitions.mirrored: A self-hosted PDF is available at mirror_url.
availability_definitions.source-only: A canonical source URL is recorded, but no self-hosted PDF is provided.
availability_definitions.metadata-only: Citation metadata is recorded, but no reliable public source URL was resolved.

collections.description: Applications and tooling for lattice proof systems.
Papers authored or co-authored by Quang Dao and linked from the homepage.
Works cited by the currently resolvable allowlisted writing sources.
Lattice folding schemes and related recursive arguments.
Formal verification and mechanized cryptographic-proof references.
Lattice-based proof systems, polynomial commitments, folding, and applications.
General SNARK, succinct-argument, polynomial-protocol, and zkVM references.
Zero-knowledge virtual machines and their proof systems.

coverage.scope_note: Citation closure covers only source trees listed in catalog-sources.json that resolve on this machine. It does not yet cover every paper on the homepage.
